question: A study is performed to assess the intelligence quotient and the crime rate in a neighborhood. Students at a local high school are given an assessment and their criminal and disciplinary records are reviewed. One of the subjects scores 2 standard deviations over the mean. What percent of students did he score higher than?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Scoring 2 standard deviations above the mean" -> "Corresponds to the 97.5th percentile on a normal distribution" -> "He scored higher than 97. -> 5%
analysis: In a normal distribution, approximately 95% of the data falls within 2 standard deviations from the mean. This means that the subject who scored 2 standard deviations above the mean would score higher than 95% of the students.
